$comment: English descriptions for the generated component reference, keyed by the source name. The Chinese descriptions are the source's own JSDoc. A source name missing here renders the source text and is reported by the generator.

symbols.en: Controlled instrument list. When set, the component syncs it into the chart's data sources.

indicators.en: Controlled indicator instances. When set, it replaces the current instances as a whole.

customMarkers.en: Controlled custom markers. When set, it replaces the current custom markers as a whole.

marketSessions.en: Market trading-session overrides for this chart instance.

yPaddingPx.en: Vertical padding inside the price pane, in CSS pixels.
yPaddingPx.zh: 价格区上下留白（CSS 像素）。

minKWidth.en: Narrowest candle width when zoomed out, in CSS pixels.
minKWidth.zh: 缩到最小时的 K 线宽度（CSS 像素）。

maxKWidth.en: Widest candle width when zoomed in, in CSS pixels.
maxKWidth.zh: 放到最大时的 K 线宽度（CSS 像素）。

rightAxisWidth.en: Width of the right price axis.

leftAxisWidth.en: Width of the left price axis; 0 hides it.

bottomAxisHeight.en: Height of the bottom time axis.

priceLabelWidth.en: Extra width of the last-price label, used for the change percentage.

initialZoomLevel.en: Zoom level at mount, from 1 to zoomLevels.

isFullscreen.en: Controlled fullscreen state. Leave it unbound and the component manages fullscreen itself.

timezone.en: IANA time zone used for dates and times on the axes and tooltips.

settings.en: Chart settings, merged per key: keys you pass win, other keys fall back to what the browser stored, then to defaults.

legend.en: Canvas legend configuration for the main pane. Core draws it; it never enters the Vue update path.

customData.en: Inline data bundle ({ symbol?, period?, data, comparisons? }). The chart uses it instead of fetching.

update:isFullscreen.zh: 供 v-model:is-fullscreen 使用的全屏状态。

themeChange.en: The user switched between light and dark.

kLineAdjustChange.en: The user picked another price adjustment.

controllerReady.en: The headless ChartController is ready; use it for imperative calls.
controllerReady.zh: 无头 ChartController 已就绪，可用于命令式调用。

source-management.en: Host-managed market-data connections and credentials. The chart never holds keys.

toolbar-start.en: Start of the top toolbar, for host controls such as an account menu.
toolbar-start.zh: 顶部工具栏起始位置，放宿主控件（如账户菜单）。

legend.en: Replaces the main pane's default legend. Receives the core legend template context.
legend.zh: 替换主图默认图例，作用域为 Core 的图例模板上下文。

kline-tooltip.en: Custom candle tooltip; rendered on hover (not on mobile) with the hovered bar.
kline-tooltip.zh: 自定义 K 线提示框，悬停时渲染（移动端除外），携带当前 K 线。

marker-tooltip.en: Custom marker tooltip; rendered while a marker is hovered.
marker-tooltip.zh: 自定义标记提示框，悬停标记时渲染。
